message:
Feat/develop regular update (#1135)

No live-market changes - interface relocation, tests, **dev** config
only.

- Interfaces moved to contracts/interfaces/, all imports re-pointed
(woof [455](https://github.com/woof-software/comet/pull/455))
- Scenarios (woof
[454](https://github.com/woof-software/comet/pull/454)): --glob flag,
setEtherBalance gas funding, Configurator + allowBySig + allow coverage;
removed dead MaticX/V2 scenarios
- Unit test: expanded allow/approve (woof
[457](https://github.com/woof-software/comet/pull/457))
- Dev config: marketAdminPermissionChecker in dev deploy, MockERC20
allowlisted
